text:
harper (Design): Quick a11y sweep request: noticed the chart legend chips have tiny focus outlines and keyboard users can't reach the ""hide series"" action inside the context menu. Also VoiceOver announces the legend label twice when opening the menu. Can we triage?
noah (Frontend): Thanks. Likely two things: CSS focus is 1px and matches background, and our menu unmounts on close which can drop tab flow. Can you paste steps?
harper (Design): Steps: Tab to legend chip -> Enter to open menu -> Tab -> focus jumps to sidebar instead of menu items. VoiceOver reads ""legend: latency"" then ""menu"" then again ""legend: latency"". Screenshot attached.
ria (A11y): Initial notes: 1) Focus visibility: use an outline with offset or >=3px stroke so it doesn't blend with chip border; add prefers-contrast handling. 2) Menu behavior: keep panel mounted during transition and manage focus trap or roving tabindex. 3) Duplicate SR announcements: suspect `aria-live` update plus `aria-expanded`; remove unnecessary live regions and ensure `aria-expanded` on trigger and `aria-labelledby` on the panel.
sam (QA): Repro on macOS + Chrome with VoiceOver and on Windows + Chrome with NVDA. I recorded a quick clip. Also saw arrow-key navigation in the legend acts inconsistently (sometimes moves page focus).
noah (Frontend): Quick stopgap CSS while we iterate on color:
```
.legend-chip:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(45,55,72,0.16); outline-offset: 2px; }
```
JS: keep menu DOM mounted with `data-closing` until transitionend; call `focus()` on first menu item when opening. Will prototype and post screenshots.
harper (Design): Neutral outline fine for now. We'll review brand-accent variant next iteration. Also prefer reduced-motion respect for the legend expand.
ria (A11y): Also add `prefers-contrast: more` to increase outline width for users who request it. Add tests for SR output to ensure single announcement.
sam (QA): I'll add a Cypress e2e: tab through legend, open menu, assert focus lands on first menuitem, test Shift+Tab returns to chip, and run VoiceOver/NVDA smoke. Marking severity P2.
noah (Frontend): I'll open PR 2033 with the CSS + DOM/focus fixes and the e2e test. Tagging @harper and @ria for review.
zebra-bot: staging deploy queued for PR 2033
harper (Design): Decision for immediate patch: 1) 3px neutral outline for legend chips, 2) keep menu mounted during animations and manage focus, 3) add prefers-reduced-motion + prefers-contrast tweaks. Follow-up: explore accent color for focus in dark theme.
sam (QA): Will smoke test once on staging. Please add a release note blurb referencing the a11y fix.
ria (A11y): :thumbsup: Thanks all. When PR is ready, please include SR test logs and note in release checklist.
